name: tet1_tau
label: theta1 Tauri (K0 IIIb red clump, Hyades; SB1 with an F dwarf)
sources: Boyajian et al. 2009, ApJ 691, 1243 (CHARA Classic, K' band): theta_LD = 2.305 +/- 0.043 mas
SIMBAD: B V (Ducati 2002 / Oja 1993), H (2MASS), K (Ducati 2002)
Boyajian et al. 2009 Table 3: T_eff, log g range, radius; masses 2.48-2.70 Msun
notes: Hyades red-clump giant (K0 III, [Fe/H] ~ +0.15). The atmosphere block names the 5000 K dwarf as a STAND-IN: no NewEra model exists at log g ~2.6; the Hyades campaigns bracket the giant between lte05000-4.50-0.0 (compact) and lte05000-0.00-0.0 (extended), with lte05000-4.50+0.5 for the metallicity (docs/hyades_ld.md).
Anchors are Vega magnitudes converted with the band table's Vega -> AB offsets; the B anchor sets the 425 nm flux for the IACT campaigns.
The radius is derived from theta_LD and the distance. At 425 nm the first null is at 1.22 lambda / theta.

SB1 (P ~ 16.3 yr) with a late-F dwarf companion ~3 % of the light (Torres et al. 1997; Boyajian 2009 corrected F_bol by 3 %); the companion is ignored here (an unresolved 3 % point source would scale |V|^2 by ~0.94 at all baselines, absorbed by the fits' free normalization).
assumptions: atmosphere.model (stand-in: a 5000 K dwarf, not a giant)
